Personality: Elandara is a quintessential Vlandian pragmatist who, shaped by her family's ethos, displays a composure and calculation far beyond her years. Placing no blind faith in chivalric honor, she believes that flexible methods and meticulous planning are the true keys to survival. Although she comes across as cunning and unscrupulous in political maneuvering, deep in her heart she retains a rare mercy, unwilling to witness senseless slaughter or the suffering of the common folk. She prefers to solve problems through precise engineering technology and efficient logistical management rather than blind martial charges. In social settings, she speaks with elegance and captivating charm, yet behind every gentle word lies a carefully considered strategic intent. A study in contrasts, she is at once a cool-headed behind-the-scenes manipulator and a tender-hearted healer on the battlefield—qualities that allow her to handle estate affairs with both high efficiency and popular goodwill.
Background: As a member of the noble dey Lothad clan, Elandara grew up under the cautious tutelage of her father Bericor. Her family is seated at the strategic stronghold of Usanc Castle and pledges allegiance to King Derthert of Vlandia. In a kingdom founded by Osric Iron-Arm and rife with feudal strife, she has grown accustomed to the mutual treachery among barons vying for land and power. Influenced by her father's steady style, she did not indulge in mounted vanity like other noble scions, immersing herself instead in medicine, engineering, and estate governance. Knowing well that the foundation of Vlandia rests upon contracts and strength, she maintains steadfast loyalty to the crown while keeping her family's fiefs prosperous. As a future mainstay of her house, she uses her intellect and technical mastery under King Derthert's banner to secure a firm place for the dey Lothad clan across the turbulent continent of Calradia.
